name: Menya Icyongereza curriculum word/phrase cache
note: Curriculum was confirmed OK by the app owner; used as the high-confidence seed for generated videos.

pairs.english: The book is on the table.
There is a pen in the bag.
There is a cat under the table.
There are three books on the table.

pairs.kinyarwanda: Uyu munsi ni ku wa mbere.

pairs.english: I go to school on Monday.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Njya ku ishuri ku wa mbere.
Uyu munsi ni ku wa kabiri.

pairs.english: My birthday is on Monday, June 5.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Umunsi wavutseho ni ku wa mbere, Kamena 5.

pairs.english: I wake up in the morning.
Kigali is bigger than my village.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Kigali ni kinini kurusha umudugudu wanjye.

pairs.english: There is a school near my house.
There are many shops in the city.
My father is taller than my brother.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Papa ni muremure kurusha umuvandimwe wanjye.

pairs.english: This house is bigger than that house.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Iyi nzu ni nini kurusha iya.

pairs.english: She goes to school every morning.
I am happy because I have a new book.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Nshimye kubera ko mfite igitabo gishya.

pairs.english: I am tired, but I am happy.
I am hungry, but I have no money.
Do you like football? — Yes, I do.
Does she like tea? — No, she doesn't.
Can I have some water, please?
Can I have some tea, please?
Where do you live? — I live in Kigali.
Why are you happy? — Because I am with my friends.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Kuki ushima? — Kubera ko ndi kumwe n'inshuti zanjye.

pairs.english: My brother is tall and young.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Umuvandimwe wanjye ni muremure kandi muto.

pairs.english: He is tall and young. He plays football every day.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Ni muremure kandi muto. Akina umupira buri munsi.

pairs.english: I am going to visit my grandmother.
Next week I am going to travel.
First, I wake up. Then, I eat.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Mbere ya byose, nkubyuka. Hanyuma, ndirya.

pairs.english: Jean goes to school in the morning.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Jean ajya ku ishuri mu gitondo.

pairs.english: I went to a birthday party.
We ate cake at the party.
They are going to have a celebration.
Did you go to school yesterday?
Did she play football on Sunday?
Did you go to school yesterday? — Yes, I did.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Wagiye ku ishuri ejo hashize? — Yego.

pairs.english: Did she play football? — No, she didn't.
Could you show me the way?
I want to send a letter.
The bank is near the station.
I am going to travel by bus.
I go to work by car.
Can you say it again, please?
You should take it to a shop.
If I am tired, I sleep.
If I am sick, I rest.
People buy rice at the market.
The shop is closed on Sunday.
I think this book is interesting.
In my opinion, it is good.
In my opinion, the film is long.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Mu bitekerezo byanjye, filime ni ndende.

pairs.english: I disagree. I think it is wrong.
pairs.kinyarwanda: Sinshobora kwemera. Ntekereza ko ari ikosa.

pairs.english: I do not agree with that.
You are invited to the wedding.
Where did you go? — I went to the market.
What did you buy? — I bought rice.
Where does he work? — He works at a bank.
Do you like football? — Yes, I do. — Who do you play with?

pairs.kinyarwanda: Ntekereza ko Kigali ari umujyi mwiza.
